kind: research-only deterministic temporal/event contract; NO strategy optimization or economic efficacy claims
data: frozen Bybit BTCUSDT 4h historical records; synthetic tests only in this iteration; all 2023-2026 history already seen
preregistered_problem: Prevent spurious/repeated MR40 entries and noncausal stop arm application while maintaining natural exit > adverse gap > previous-stop touch > new entry ordering.
source_truth: MR40+Momentum30 source produces bool entry on fully closed candle, Z<=-2 and 180-bar momentum filter; exits Z>=0 at closed candle. The coordinator does NOT recompute indicators.
fixed_rules: Only first confirmed CLOSED signal of each contiguous positive MR40 episode eligible; veto consumes episode, no delayed reentry until a confirmed non-signal reset.
Next-open entry intent only, never at the signal candle's close; any pending entry expires after one index.
If a valid Position is open, previously confirmed natural exit at next open has priority over stop/gap and forbids same-bar entry.
Without natural exit, next-open adverse gap through active stop produces separate stop-gap event; historical bar LOW <= stop produces unverified intrabar-stop-touch event, never an actual fill.

Profit arm when a fully confirmed close >= position entry * 1.02 schedules gross entry-level stop from NEXT bar open only; no close-based retroactive protective exit; profit trigger does not prove net breakeven.
Missing candle, incorrect index, crossed/invalid OHLC, bad data or unknown source identity yields DATA_BLOCK rather than trade intent.
Never call private API, place orders, compute actual fill price, or update Paper; integration/valuation happens only after independent evaluation.
acceptance: Synthetic tests must prove 1-bar entry deferral and no repeated / vetoed episode reentry.
Natural exit > gap stop > intrabar low stop > entry precedence must hold.
No future close or current-bar high/low influences a new entry selection.
Profit ratchet cannot act until next bar; gating source gaps/stale inputs must suppress intents.
Default baseline arm/stop disabled; candidate +2% arm is research-only and NOT promoted; preserve previously failed economic gates.
